name: Brisa de Verano
source:
Welcome to a new Asraventure where you can meet the characters from "En el Ojo de la Tormenta", the sequel to "Un Barco en el Cielo". This little game is CANON to the books, and YOU are the protagonists.

[Translated from [url=https://asrahasnochill.itch.io/brisa-de-verano]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到新的阿斯拉冒险世界，在这里你可以见到《Un Barco en el Cielo》的续集《En el Ojo de la Tormenta》中的角色。这个小游戏是书中的佳能，而你就是主角。

[译自[url=https://asrahasnochill.itch.io/brisa-de-verano]Itch.io[/url]]
